text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Hokko Tarumae's debut race drawing 
near, the earnest girl was putting too 
much pressure on herself for her hometown, 
risking underperforming on race day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer shows Hokko Tarumae a cheer 
video from the people of Tomakomai. Their 
warm words put her heart at ease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, looking at her training data 
and feeling her growth in solid numbers 
allowed Hokko Tarumae to blow away her 
anxieties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then came the day of her debut race. 
Hokko Tarumae resolved to run with all her 
might for the sake of everyone supporting 
her!
